title: Projective blowups: a formal and multicentered proof
summary: We give a machine-checked proof, in Lean 4, of the universal property of multicentered blowups: given a finite family $Z$ of closed subschemes of a scheme $X$, presented on each chart by ideals, there is a scheme $\Bl_Z X$ over $X$, terminal among $X$-schemes on which every member of the family becomes an effective Cartier divisor. To the best of our knowledge this is the first formalisation of blowups, single- or multicentered, in any theorem prover.
